states.treatment: room waking: closed notebook, lamp beginning to glow, first light entering, sparse objects emerging from mist
calm attentive equilibrium: open blank notebook, steady cup or vessel, diffuse light, and barely perceptible moving air
active but not urgent: a curtain or paper edge lifted by air, water surface rippling, stronger directional light, and slightly more spatial energy
settling into order: papers aligned, pen capped, vessels upright, light becoming even, and a consolidated composition
deliberate stillness: tied or closed notebook, motion suspended, saturation softened, and a quiet resting arrangement
reduced reliability: denser haze or rain, uneven light, one slightly displaced object, and a restrained amber accent while remaining readable
decisive disruption: stormier contrast, one sharply displaced harmless object, and a restrained rust-coral thread or accent without danger symbols
closed stillness: emptying light, closed notebook, very few objects, almost no motion, and a pale restful finish rather than darkness
